title: Comparison stage semantics
statement: Fix $E,B\in\mathbb N$, an oracle $\mathrm{orc}:\{0,1,2,3\}\times\{0,1\}^*\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, an input bit string $x$, a proposition $Q$, and a register state $\sigma$ consisting of the seventeen natural-number quantities specified for the counting procedure. Suppose each quantity in $\sigma$ is at most $B$ and $\sigma.s+1\le B$. If $\sigma.cp\ne\sigma.n$, assume the procedure started in round state $\mathrm{rd}(\mathrm{false},E)$ with $n$ replaced by $\sigma.cp$ and $s$ replaced by $\sigma.s+1$ terminates with all registers at most $B$, and accepts if and only if $Q$ holds. Then, started in comparison state $\mathrm{cmp}$ with state $\sigma$, it terminates with all registers at most $B$ and accepts if and only if $\sigma.cp=\sigma.n$ or both $\sigma.cp\ne\sigma.n$ and $Q$ hold.
